person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: rapid changes in A1 spectrotemporal receptive fields while an animal detects a tone in noise
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: whether the magnitude of task-driven receptive field plasticity depends on task difficulty, and whether the change is one of gain or of shape
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: separates gain from shape change and shows they move in opposite directions, with the sign of the net effect set jointly by task difficulty and by the cell's distance from the target frequency

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Lowering target SNR raises the attentional effort the animal must invest, and that increased effort drives larger adaptive changes in the receptive field
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Pulling a tone out of a masker requires simultaneously suppressing the responses driven by the concurrent noise and enhancing sensitivity to the tone
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Which direction a cell changes is set by what drives it: near cells are enhanced by proximity to the target tone, far cells are suppressed because the behaviourally relevant broadband masker drives them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a contrast matched filter: the acoustic features of the foreground are enhanced and those of the background suppressed
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the net effect keeps the target salient by two different routes - enhancing near cells when the tone is loud, suppressing far cells when it is buried
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the active STRF is modelled explicitly as a scaled passive STRF plus an orthogonal shape change, S_d = g.S_b + delta
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: STRFs are measured from the reference TORCs alone, never during target presentation, so the measurement does not include the target
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: attentional load is validated behaviourally by inserting identical intermediate-difficulty probes into easy and hard blocks
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: STRF frequency resolution is too coarse to exclude that some A1 neurons build narrow matched filters at the exact target frequency.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: It is unknown how far the gain-reduction/shape-enhancement pattern is specific to the tone-in-noise task, its avoidance paradigm, or the fixed noise level.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Most cells could not be held across multiple task conditions, so difficulty comparisons are largely between rather than within cells.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Disentangling stimulus structure from behavioural paradigm requires further experiments; the interpretations offered are conjectures.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The 0.6-octave boundary dividing near from far cells was an arbitrary choice.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the near/far dividing line is arbitrary, stated as such, and shown not to change the results
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the standard STRF power normalisation used in the group's previous papers does not separate gain from shape

span.label: shape
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: plasticity here is rapid and reversible - measured as the difference between active and passive STRFs within a session, not as learning
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: task difficulty is operationalised as target SNR, and validated separately by lick withdrawal time and by probe-trial performance
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: gain and shape are given distinct definitions by an explicit model: gain is the fraction of the STRF that keeps its original shape, shape change is the orthogonal remainder
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: near and far are defined by a 0.6-octave cut from the target frequency, which the paper calls arbitrary and tests
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: method: STRFs measured from responses to modulated broadband TORC references during and before a conditioned-avoidance tone-in-noise detection task, at target SNRs from +15 to -10 dB
span.note: a second reading DIFFERING from the recorded value. Recorded: electrophysiology — a second reading, verbatim-verified, disagreeing with the value on the record. Not applied - a person decides.

span.label: phenomenon: attention-driven receptive field plasticity in primary auditory cortex

span.label: extends → Fritz et al. (2003; 2005; 2007a,b), the group's earlier demonstrations of rapid task-related STRF plasticity with pure-tone targets
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: builds-on → the "contrast matched filter" hypothesis of Fritz et al. (2007a)
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: extends → visual studies of task difficulty and attention (Boudreau et al., 2006; Spitzer et al., 1988; Spitzer and Richmond, 1991), which did not separate gain from shape
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS GAIN AGAINST SHAPE. 'Quotation withheld' Two ways a receptive field can change that a single measure cannot separate - so the earlier result is a sum of two effects that this paper's [7] then shows move differently with difficulty. Q-511.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: replicates → earlier task-related plasticity results from the same group in tone-versus-TORC and tone-versus-tone paradigms (Fritz et al., 2003; 2005; 2007b)
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: extends → Fritz et al. on rapid STRF plasticity with pure-tone targets
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: qualifies → the contrast matched filter model, by showing the sign of the change depends on difficulty and on distance from target
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS DISTANCE FROM THE TARGET FREQUENCY, AND THE SIGN FLIPS ACROSS IT. 'when we grouped the plasticity changes by near and far cells, it became apparent that NEAR CELLS ON AVERAGE WERE ENHANCED (red) WHEREAS FAR CELLS WERE SUPPRESSED (blue).' The matched-filter model is qualified rather than refuted: it holds, with a sign that depends on where the cell sits. Q-442.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: extends → visual studies showing task difficulty enhances attentional modulation, which did not separate gain from shape
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS GAIN AGAINST SHAPE, on a second target. Same sentence as [2]: 'THESE MEASUREMENTS DID NOT DISTINGUISH RECEPTIVE FIELD GAIN FROM SHAPE CHANGES.' One limitation of one earlier method, disqualifying it for two different claims this paper makes - which is why the sentence supports two rows rather than one. Q-511.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: qualifies → their own gain-versus-difficulty result, which did not survive pooling across performance levels
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS WHETHER THE CELLS ARE POOLED ACROSS PERFORMANCE LEVELS. 'Quotation withheld.' The paper's own effect survives one analysis choice and not another, and it says which - an analyst decision reported as a result rather than buried in methods. Q-503.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Engaging in the detection task reduced overall STRF gain in the majority of recorded cells relative to the passive state.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Shape changes, unlike gain changes, were excitatory and frequency-specific, concentrated in cells tuned near the target tone.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The combined gain and shape adaptations sharpened the target-versus-noise representation differently at high and low SNR.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The magnitude of receptive-field adaptation tracked behavioural performance, being greatest in the best-performing sessions.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Suppression of receptive fields grew as the task became harder and reached significance only in the low-SNR condition.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Behaviourally, lick withdrawal time lengthened as target SNR fell, in all three ferrets.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Identical intermediate-difficulty probe trials were detected better inside difficult blocks than inside easy blocks, indicating higher attentional engagement during hard tasks.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Naive animals exposed to the identical stimuli showed no consistent receptive-field changes, so behaviour is required for the plasticity.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The gain reduction was a broad, difficulty-independent effect present in near and far cells alike, in contrast to the difficulty-dependent shape changes.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
